about.purpose: Extends the Design Release 2.1 business review plan (cards.json) with the type question and templates theme: one card per change a user would notice, the open questions to put first, and the screenshots to capture. Built from the 13 rows marked done in themes/type-question-and-templates. The 9 rows still to do are listed in stillToCome, not carded. The dropped row inc-163 'Edit a whole saved template on its own task list' is not carded either: a saved template is changed one section at a time instead.
about.capture: As cards.json: same data, same viewport (desktop 1280 wide, full page), JavaScript on. Most of these pages do not exist on main, so each shot says beforeExists. Where it is false, beforeShows says what main shows at that point instead, if anything; compare is 'before-and-after' only when that is worth a picture, otherwise 'after-only'.

routes.INS: Home / (Dashboard). The type question /notification-type (from Create new). Its template version /notification-type/template (from Create new template on Manage templates). Both are on the INS front door, which hands over to the animals or plants service.
routes.live animals: Start from the INS question: /live-animals/start (creates the draft, opens origin). Manage templates /live-animals/templates. Template name /live-animals/templates/new?type=live-animals, and /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/name once started. While a template is being created, its pages are /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/{slug} (the same slugs as a notification, without accompanying-documents, declaration and confirmation), its task list is /live-animals/templates/{templateId} and its review is /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/notification-view. Once saved, /live-animals/templates/{templateId} is the template's own page, and a Change link opens /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/{slug}?change=1. Use template is a form on the card or page that posts to /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/use and opens the new notification's overview /live-animals/notifications/{id}.
routes.plants: Start from the INS question: /high-risk-plants/start (creates the draft, opens /high-risk-plants/notifications/{id}/commodity-type). Plants has no templates pages; its Templates item links to the animals service's Manage templates.

testData.weekly-cattle: A live animals template named 'Weekly cattle from France': origin France, region code No, internal reference WEEKLY-01, Bos taurus ticked on 'What are you importing?', nothing else answered. The tests repo's save-template.spec.ts saveTemplate walk, with that name and reference.
testData.weekly-cattle-full: As weekly-cattle, plus Commodity details with 3 animals for each species and 1 package (use-template.spec.ts saveTemplate), and on Roles and addresses a place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer and place of destination picked from the address book, then a contact address (template-parties.spec.ts). Any saved address-book entries will do; the spec creates its own through the address book.
testData.empty-templates-user: A user who has never saved a template: the tests repo's users.sarah on her Gatwick Airport organisation (manage-templates.spec.ts), signed in from a fresh browser.

notes: The main plan's open question q-welsh-drafts covers this theme's new Welsh text too: 'Create new', 'Use template', 'Templates' ('Templedi') and every templates page are machine-drafted.

Prototype screens not used: notification-hub--template.png (the dropped whole-template edit), templates-discard.png, templates--deleted.png and templates-arena-aintree-delete.png (discarding and deleting a template, still to come).

The main plan's i-home shot will also show Create new and Use template on the combined side. i-t-home here is the same page, captured for this theme's cards with its navigation and button links recorded.

cards.title: Starting a notification from the INS home asks what you are importing first
cards.whatChanged: Before, the INS home's only way to start was a 'Start a new notification' button, shown only when the organisation had no notifications, and it opened the live animals notification list. Now 'Create new' opens a new page, 'What are you importing?', under the caption 'About the consignment', with five options and none chosen: Live animals; Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos); Plants for planting; Potatoes (seed and ware); Wood products. It has a single Continue button, a Back link to the INS home and no Draft tag or reference, and Dashboard stays highlighted in the navigation. Continuing with nothing chosen shows 'Select what you are importing'. No notification exists until an option is chosen and Continue pressed. Live animals then opens a new live animals draft on Origin of the import, with its Draft tag and GBN-AG reference. A plants option opens a new plants draft (see the next card but one). Germinal products goes to where the germinal products service will start, which is not built yet. Leaving with Back creates nothing. Starting from the live animals or plants notification list still skips the question.

openQuestions.title: Should a template call section 4 'Consignment parties' or 'Consignment addresses'?
openQuestions.question: The notification review now calls this section 'Consignment addresses', and Design Release 2.1's template review does too. A template's task list, review and saved page all say '4. Consignment parties'. Which should a template use?
openQuestions.asBuilt: The template's task list, the template review and the saved template's page all head section 4 '4. Consignment parties', matching the overview's own section name (a notification's overview says '5. Consignment parties'). The notification review's section reads 'Consignment addresses' and its card 'Addresses'. The template review and page use the 'Addresses' card, so on one page the section says 'parties' and the card says 'Addresses'. This was kept as the templates theme built it when the two themes were merged.

openQuestions.title: Is Back to the task list right on the template review?
openQuestions.question: On the template review, the Back link goes to the template's task list. Is that right? The row still to come, 'Back links follow the context a page was opened in', may change how Back links behave across the journey.
openQuestions.asBuilt: Template review: Back goes to the template's task list, as Design Release 2.1 draws it. Notification review (draft): Back goes to the live animals notification list. While amending: Back goes to the overview. The task list is the only way into the template review, so Back returns to where the trader came from.

openQuestions.title: Plants traders are asked what they are importing twice, in different words
openQuestions.question: A trader who chooses a plants type on the INS question lands on plants' own 'What are you importing?' with nothing chosen and different option names. Is answering twice acceptable for now, or should plants use the INS answer? Should the option names match? And should plants' Back link go back to the INS question?
openQuestions.asBuilt: The INS question offers 'Plants for planting', 'Potatoes (seed and ware)' and 'Wood products'. Plants' first page offers 'Potatoes (seed or ware)', 'Plants for planting' and 'Wood and cut trees', with nothing chosen. The plants draft already exists at this point. The Back link goes to the plants notification list. The templates ruling expects plants' first page to be its own type question, so the INS answer is not passed on.

openQuestions.title: Germinal products is offered before the germinal products service exists
openQuestions.question: Should 'Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos)' be offered on both versions of 'What are you importing?' before the germinal products service is built, or hidden until then?
openQuestions.asBuilt: On the INS question, Germinal products sends the trader to the address where the germinal products service will start, which shows page not found today. On the template version, Germinal products goes on to the template name page, but 'Save and continue' there returns to Manage templates with nothing saved and no message. Both are the behaviour the 9 October ruling allows until the germinal set is built.

openQuestions.title: The template page shows a Delete button that does not work yet
openQuestions.question: The template page shows a red 'Delete' button, but deleting a template is a row still to come. Is it acceptable to show the button before it works, or should it wait for that row?
openQuestions.asBuilt: Delete links to the template's delete address, which no page answers yet, so it shows page not found. The row 'Template review ends with Save template and Delete, and a saved template can be deleted' builds the confirmation page and the deleting.

openQuestions.title: Which answers must a template have?
openQuestions.question: While a template is being built, should a page insist on its required answers when the trader presses 'Save and continue', or may a template leave them blank? This was not settled by the ruling or the design, so a default was built.
openQuestions.asBuilt: As for a notification: an answer in the wrong format is refused, 'Save and continue' needs the page's required answers (for example, choosing Yes for a region code without entering one shows an error), and 'Save and return to overview' saves without them. Origin, the first page after the name, offers only 'Save and continue', so a trader must answer origin before going further. The template's name is optional, no arrival date is kept, and a template can be saved with sections unanswered.

openQuestions.title: Should a template keep animal identification details?
openQuestions.question: Ear tags and passports belong to particular animals, so they are likely to differ every time. Should a template keep them and copy them into each new notification?
openQuestions.asBuilt: A template keeps whatever identification details were entered. Its page shows them inside the commodity card, and 'Use template' copies them into the new notification. Design Release 2.1's template review for cattle shows no identification details. The built template review shows them inside the commodity card whenever they were entered (not yet checked on a merged stack).

shots.howToReach: On /live-animals/templates press 'View template' on the 'Weekly cattle, all parties' card; lands on /live-animals/templates/{templateId}.
shots.alsoCapture: Browser title, the Back link's href, the section headings and every Change link's href.

shots.page: Page after pressing Delete on a saved template's page
shots.state: Any saved template, Delete pressed
shots.howToReach: On a template's page press 'Delete'. Capture the landing page (/live-animals/templates/{templateId}/delete).

shots.page: Origin of the import, changing a saved template
shots.state: weekly-cattle-full, Change on the Origin of import card
shots.howToReach: On the template's page press 'Change' on the Origin of import card; lands on /live-animals/templates/{templateId}/origin?change=1, filled in.
shots.alsoCapture: The Back link's href and every button and link at the foot of the page.

shots.page: A saved template's page after changing a section
shots.state: Internal reference changed to WEEKLY-02, Save and return pressed
shots.howToReach: On the change of origin replace the internal reference with WEEKLY-02 and press 'Save and return'; lands on the template's page with the banner.
shots.alsoCapture: The banner heading and the 'Date created' line.

shots.page: Overview of a notification started from a template
shots.state: Use template pressed on the 'Weekly cattle, all parties' card
shots.howToReach: On /live-animals/templates press 'Use template' on the 'Weekly cattle, all parties' card; lands on /live-animals/notifications/{id}.
shots.beforeShows: The overview exists on main, but a new notification there always starts empty; there is no way to start one from a template.
shots.alsoCapture: The reference, the status tag and each task's Complete or To do tag.

shots.page: Review of a notification started from a template
shots.state: As a-t-template-used-overview, Review and submit pressed
shots.howToReach: From the new notification's overview press 'Review and submit'; lands on /live-animals/notifications/{id}/notification-view.
shots.beforeShows: The review exists on main, but never with answers copied from a template.
